login.title: DSH Remote
login.subtitle: Sign in to your DSH Remote Server account to reach your Harness hosts.
login.serverHint: Usually the HTTPS address shown on your computer.
login.oauthHint: A browser window opens to finish authorization, then returns here.
login.qrHint: If the browser does not return to the app automatically, use this: open the authorization page, confirm, and the app completes sign-in.
login.qrWaiting: Waiting for confirmation in the browser…

hosts.title: Hosts
hosts.empty: No hosts are registered under this account. Start the Host plugin on your machine, then refresh.

errors.connectionReplaced: This connection was taken over by another window.
errors.identityNotReady: The device identity is not ready yet. Try again shortly.
errors.zhihuUnsupported: This server does not support Zhihu authorization. Use another sign-in method.
errors.githubUnsupported: This server does not support GitHub authorization. Use another sign-in method.
errors.oauthCancelled: Authorization was not completed ({{code}}). Please try again.
errors.oauthInvalid: The sign-in information has expired. Sign in again.
errors.zhihuOauthFailed: Zhihu authorization failed: the server could not exchange the login token. Retry shortly or check the server's OAuth configuration.
errors.githubOauthFailed: GitHub authorization failed: the server could not exchange the login token. Check the server's GitHub OAuth App configuration (client secret) and retry.
